purpose: Form CHG-2 is the certificate of registration issued by the Registrar when a charge is registered under sub-section (1) of Section 77 or section 78.
who: Not stated in the Rules text
when: Not stated in the Rules text
steps: Register a charge with the Registrar under sub-section (1) of Section 77 or section 78.
Wait for the Registrar to issue the certificate of registration.
Receive Form No. CHG-2 from the Registrar as evidence of compliance.
checklist: Ensure the charge is registered under section 77 sub-section (1) or section 78.
watch: The certificate issued is conclusive evidence that the requirements of Chapter VI and its rules have been met.
